question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` continue accepting equivalent decimal integer spellings such as `+500` and `0500`, or become a canonical-text-only CLI contract?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow but intentionally rejects previously accepted invocations without demonstrating a semantic cadence error, so repository history and tests cannot determine the desired user-facing compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Keep equivalent integer spellings working because they resolve to the same interval and no canonical-text contract is currently established.

options.title: Adopt canonical-only syntax
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document the exact accepted syntax, and require real CLI before/after/control proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Keep equivalent integer spellings working because they resolve to the same interval and no canonical-text contract is currently established.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Policy CLI and accepted-attestation watch behavior containing this parser.
